neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of bonsai1/L18/N624+ (repeat mention of a rare multi-piece name); drop only 0.06, and the label has little to do with the feeder's: a single 'A.D.' fires as much as a repeated one, and a repeated surname barely moves it (0.17). Near misses are plain-prose twins of each fire sentence carrying the same meaning without shorthand. Ruled out while probing: 'the slot before a number' (Turn to page / Flight number < 0.14); abbreviations alone with no codes or numbers reach only ~0.2. Inverse solver (DE): no silent on-concept text; a 0.34 leak only from concatenated prose (each piece alone 0.12-0.18), consistent with the card's dense flag (14% of tokens >= 0.1 of max). Chat was quiet this mission.
